Name: More Ice Cream Flavors
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=6]Currently compatible with 1.6 Update[/size]


[line]

[size=5]Features[/size]

This mod adds 8 more ice cream flavors to Stardew Valley:

[spoiler]
Strawberry
Cherry
Chocolate
Cookie Dough
Mint Chip
Toffee
Cookies & Cream
Neopolitan
[/spoiler]

I recommend installing my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16334]Ice Cream Replacer[/url] mod to make the "vanilla" ice cream flavor match the visual style of the new flavors.

I may add more recipes in future updates. You can purchase them from Gus after getting 7 hearts with Jodi (this is when you get the original
recipe for ice cream). I may change this if requested.



[size=5]Update Log[/size]

Version 1.0.2 I forgot to add update keys to the manifest in the first 2 versions. The newest file now has the updated manifest and will now inform you of updates.

Version 1.1.0 Added 2 new flavors, Cookies & Cream and Neopolitan. Added compatibility with 1.6. Updated sprite textures. No longer requires Json Assets.

Version 1.1.1 Alex now sells all flavors at the ice cream stand in summer.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download ONE of the main files of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
